_: The treehouse is the Ent's own (Ed, 2026-10-23: "The layout doesn't have to be all right-angles; the corridors are tree branches, the rooms are probably round"; the mock he OKd, previews/ed/treehouse-layout-v3/mock2): round plank rooms on the Ent, joined by bark-covered branches, off the Terrace (the hub and its balcony, its walls and map gone: art/ent.js), drawn by the game (render/houseRooms.ts, render/houseArt.ts) and walked as one floor with the Terrace (rules/houseRooms.ts). A file a room (housekeeping, Ed 2026-10-23: so pull requests on different rooms stop colliding): config/house/rooms/<id>.json holds a room's place on the plan (by its parent: a bearing, a branch, a radius; Ed's room graph, previews/ed/treehouse-layout-v3/ed-graph.md) and its objects, this file the house's own numbers (hub: the Terrace's radius; branchWidth), put together by config/house/assemble.js (which says what each holds); node tools/house/organic.mjs checks no rooms crowd. Metres from the hub's centre, x east, z south (turn 0: the plan unturned; organic: the Ent's own house). Each room: its bounds (x0..x1, z0..z1) and its radius r about their middle; locked: drawn but shut, its branch ending at its door (Bedrooms 2 and 3, one for each other witch: Ed, 2026-10-21, "We will have three bedrooms, one for each witch"; 2026-10-23, "locked. The branch stops at the door"). Each branch: its middle line (pts), its width (w) and its bounds; it runs 1.4 m into the floors it joins, so the walk runs on through. wall: the walls' height (m), as drawn. Each object: a box on the plan (Alpha draws furniture by id and footprint): its room, its middle (x, z), its footprint (w along x, d along z) and height (h), its label, and what E does there (use): creator (the creator opened at only these choices: axes, wear and parts, as ui/creator.ts BOXES names them; spell: the Hat or Broom box's power row too), hats (the hats' floor: hats lie there as objects, E picks one up or puts hers down), bed (held E ends the night), curtains (the bedroom's window: shut while she wakes, open by themselves once the island's ready; rules/wakeUp.ts), zoo (the bestiary's book: the zoo over the night), telescope (the crow's nest's: looking round the island through it, rules/telescope.ts), chart (the Atrium's map table: the sea chart; Ed, 2026-10-23), or say (a placeholder: a one-line bubble). reach: how far past an object's edge E reaches it (m). Each witch's own dressing is in her bedroom (the dressing table, the wardrobe, the cloak pegs, the shoe rack); the shared things are past its door (the Parlour's mirror and hats' floor, the Study's bags, the Workshop's broom stand).
